violations.why: irq_kestrel is never masked and can decrement between the task's write at 30 and its read at 21, so the check sees a modified value.
Only interrupt 1 is disabled, so irq_kestrel can modify the value after the check at 21 and before the write at 22. The check is then stale and the decrement is overwritten.
irq_kestrel can read the value between the task's two writes, at 30 and 22, and observe an intermediate state.
irq_willow is still enabled between line 30 and the disable_isr(1) at line 20, so its increment can land before the read at 21.
irq_willow can read the value after the write at 30, before it is masked at line 20, and it sees an intermediate state before the task's write at 22.
irq_kestrel has higher priority and can preempt irq_willow between the read and write of v_basalt++. The decrement is then lost.
